answers.q1: Maven via the wrapper (Java 17). A Gradle build also exists, but CI's main build uses Maven. Install dependencies with: ./mvnw dependency:go-offline
answers.q2: ./mvnw test (CI runs the full build with ./mvnw -B verify, which also runs the tests)
answers.q4: ./mvnw -B verify. This is what CI runs. Its validate phase runs spring-javaformat:validate and the nohttp checkstyle check. To run only those two checks: ./mvnw spring-javaformat:validate checkstyle:check@nohttp-checkstyle-validation. To fix formatting: ./mvnw spring-javaformat:apply
answers.q5: src/main/resources/static/resources/css/petclinic.css is compiled from src/main/scss/*.scss by the 'css' Maven profile, so edit the SCSS instead. Build output in target/ and build/ and the .gradle/ directory are also generated. The wrapper files (.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar, gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar, mvnw, mvnw.cmd, gradlew, gradlew.bat) are vendored. The block between the agentbrief:start and agentbrief:end markers in AGENTS.md is generated by 'agentbrief sync'.
